wanda: The name of the special page for this extension
wanda-chat-welcometext: Welcome message displayed in the chatbot
wanda-chat-welcomedesc: Description message to the user, displayed in the chatbot
wanda-chat-instruction1: Instruction shown to the user in the chatbot
wanda-chat-instruction2: Instruction shown to the user in the chatbot
wanda-chat-pdftotext-error: Error message to notify the user that there is a problem with a utility setup
wanda-floating-chat-title: Tooltip text for the floating chat button
wanda-api-error-empty-question: Error message when user submits an empty question
wanda-api-error-temperature-invalid: Error message when temperature value is not numeric
wanda-api-error-temperature-outofrange: Error message when temperature value is out of range.
wanda-api-error-config-invalid: Error message when the chat service is not properly configured
wanda-api-error-no-index: Error message when no Elasticsearch index is found
wanda-api-error-no-results: Error message when no relevant information is found in the wiki
wanda-api-error-generation-failed: Error message when LLM response generation fails
wanda-api-error-openai-key: Error message when OpenAI API key is not configured
wanda-api-error-anthropic-key: Error message when Anthropic API key is not configured
wanda-api-error-azure-key: Error message when Azure API key is not configured
wanda-api-error-gemini-key: Error message when Gemini (Google Generative Language) API key is not configured
wanda-api-error-token-limit:
Error message when the LLM response was truncated because it exceeded the maximum token limit.
Parameters: $1 - The maximum token limit value
wanda-api-error-fallback: Default fallback message when LLM cannot provide a response
wanda-llm-response-nocontext: Default response for questions which cannot be answered using wiki context
wanda-toggle-public-knowledge-label: Label for the toggle that lets the user allow using public LLM knowledge in addition to wiki context
wanda-toggle-public-knowledge-help: Short helper text shown next to the toggle explaining what it does
wanda-toggle-public-knowledge-aria: ARIA label for the toggle to use LLM knowledge
wanda-floating-chat-header: Header text displayed at the top of the floating chat window
wanda-attach-image-title: Tooltip text for the button that opens the image picker to attach images from the wiki
wanda-remove-image-aria: ARIA label for the button that removes an attached image from the message
wanda-image-picker-title: Title of the dialog window where users can search and select images from the wiki
wanda-image-search-placeholder: Placeholder text in the search input field for finding images
wanda-image-search-placeholder-text: Placeholder message displayed in the empty search results area before any search is performed
wanda-image-no-results: Message displayed when the image search returns no results
wanda-image-search-error: Error message displayed when there is a problem searching for images
wanda-image-too-large:
Error message displayed when user tries to attach an image that exceeds the size limit.
Parameters: $1 - Maximum allowed file size (e.g., '5 MB')
wanda-image-limit-reached:
Error message displayed when user tries to attach more than the maximum allowed number of images.
Parameters: $1 - Maximum number of images allowed
wanda-close: Label for the close button in dialogs and modal windows
wanda-clear-conversation: Label for the button that clears the current conversation history
wanda-clear-conversation-aria: ARIA label for the button that clears the conversation history
wanda-toggle-memory-label: Label for the toggle that enables or disables conversation memory
wanda-toggle-memory-aria: ARIA label for the conversation memory toggle checkbox
wanda-cargo-query-error: Error message when a Cargo structured data query fails to execute
wanda-cargo-no-tables: Message displayed when no Cargo tables are available for querying
wanda-cargo-query-failed: Message displayed when a Cargo query returns no results
wanda-cargo-multistep-max-reached:
Log message when the maximum number of sequential Cargo query steps is reached.
Parameters: $1 - Maximum number of steps allowed
wanda-thinking-label: Label for the collapsible section that shows the reasoning steps performed during Cargo data retrieval
wanda-wikibase-query-error: Error message when a Wikibase SPARQL query fails to execute
wanda-wikibase-no-results: Message displayed when a Wikibase SPARQL query returns no results
wanda-wikibase-sparql-error: Error message when the SPARQL query cannot be sent to the endpoint
wanda-wikibase-multistep-max-reached:
Log message when the maximum number of sequential Wikibase query steps is reached.
Parameters: $1 - Maximum number of steps allowed
wanda-smw-query-error: Error message when a Semantic MediaWiki query fails to execute
wanda-smw-not-available: Message displayed when the Semantic MediaWiki extension is not installed
wanda-smw-no-properties: Message displayed when no Semantic MediaWiki properties are available for querying
wanda-smw-query-failed: Message displayed when a Semantic MediaWiki query returns no results
wanda-smw-multistep-max-reached:
Log message when the maximum number of sequential Semantic MediaWiki query steps is reached.
Parameters: $1 - Maximum number of steps allowed
wanda-edit-card-heading: Heading shown above the AI editing controls (edit mode checkbox and page name input), labeling that section as a distinct feature
wanda-toggle-edit-label: Label for the checkbox that enables Wanda's edit mode
wanda-toggle-edit-aria: Accessible label for the edit mode toggle checkbox
wanda-edit-target-label: Label for the input where the user types the page title to edit or create
wanda-edit-preview-title: Title of the dialog that previews the proposed edit before it is applied
wanda-edit-apply: Label for the button that applies (saves) the previewed edit
wanda-edit-cancel: Label for the button that cancels the previewed edit
wanda-edit-no-change: Message shown when Wanda did not propose any change for the edit request
wanda-edit-success: Message shown after an edit is saved successfully; followed by a link to the page
wanda-edit-created: Message shown after a new page is created successfully; followed by a link to the page
wanda-edit-error: Generic error message shown when an edit could not be completed
wanda-edit-notitle: Notification shown when the user enables edit mode but provides no target page
wanda-edit-summary:
Edit summary used for AI-assisted edits.
Parameters: $1 - The user's editing instruction
tag-wanda: The name (short description) of the change tag applied to edits made through Wanda. Shown in page history and RecentChanges. {{doc-important|Keep this short.}}
tag-wanda-description: Longer description of the [[Special:Tags|change tag]] applied to edits made through Wanda.
wanda-api-error-edit-disabled: API error when editing via Wanda is disabled by configuration
wanda-api-error-edit-permission: API error when the user lacks permission to edit pages with Wanda
wanda-api-error-edit-notitle: API error when the target page title is missing or invalid
wanda-api-error-edit-failed: API error when the edit could not be saved
wanda-api-error-edit-readonly: API error when the wiki is in read-only mode
wanda-api-error-edit-store-failed: API error when the server-side edit proposal store is unavailable
wanda-api-error-edit-invalid-record: API error when a stored batch or proposal record is missing or corrupt
wanda-api-error-edit-busy: API error when a concurrent request for the same batch or proposal is already running
wanda-api-error-edit-source-unsupported: API error when a requested research source is not available
wanda-api-error-edit-context-required: API error when a preview is requested before its required research context has been retrieved
wanda-api-error-edit-no-candidates: API error when no eligible pages were found for a batch edit request
wanda-api-error-edit-context-failed: API error when research context retrieval failed
wanda-api-error-edit-context-empty: API error when research context retrieval returned no usable content
wanda-api-error-edit-not-candidate: API error when the requested page is not part of the current batch
wanda-api-error-edit-preview-failed: API error when generating a preview for a page failed
wanda-api-error-edit-stale: API error when the page changed since the edit was previewed
wanda-api-error-edit-save-uncertain: API error when Wanda could not confirm whether an edit was saved
wanda-api-error-edit-namespace: API error when the target page is outside the namespaces Wanda is allowed to edit
wanda-api-error-edit-too-large: API error when the page is too large for Wanda to edit
wanda-api-error-edit-rate-limited: API error when the user has made too many edit requests recently
wanda-api-error-edit-plan-failed: API error when Wanda could not plan a batch edit request
wanda-edit-target-help: Help text shown under the edit target input, explaining that leaving it blank triggers a batch/multi-page edit search
wanda-edit-scope:
Label showing the discovered scope of a batch edit request.
Parameters: $1 - Scope description (e.g. "search: some query")
wanda-edit-truncated:
Warning shown when more candidate pages were found than could be shown.
Parameters: $1 - Maximum number of pages shown
wanda-edit-candidates: Heading for the list of candidate pages in a batch edit
wanda-edit-no-candidates: Message shown when no candidate pages were found for a batch edit request
wanda-edit-research: Heading for the research/context retrieval section of the batch edit review dialog
wanda-edit-research-pending: Status label shown next to a research source before retrieval has started
wanda-edit-research-running: Status label shown next to a research source while it is being retrieved
wanda-edit-research-done: Status label shown next to a research source once retrieval has completed
wanda-edit-research-failed: Status label shown next to a research source when retrieval failed
wanda-edit-planning: Status message shown while Wanda is planning a batch edit request
wanda-edit-generating: Status message shown while Wanda is generating edit previews
wanda-edit-applying: Status message shown while Wanda is applying selected edits
wanda-edit-stopped: Message shown after the user stops an in-progress batch edit operation
wanda-edit-select-proposal:
Label for the checkbox that approves applying a previewed edit to a specific page.
Parameters: $1 - Page title
wanda-edit-show-diff: Label for the expandable control that reveals the diff for a previewed edit
wanda-edit-provenance: Heading for the list of sources a proposed edit's facts were drawn from
wanda-edit-view-result:
Link text shown after an edit is applied, linking to the resulting revision.
Parameters: $1 - New revision ID, $2 - Page title
wanda-edit-generate-previews: Label for the button that generates previews for the selected candidate pages
wanda-edit-apply-selected: Label for the button that applies all approved edits
wanda-edit-stop: Label for the button that stops an in-progress batch edit operation
wanda-edit-status-pending: Status label for a candidate page before its preview has been generated
wanda-edit-status-previewing: Status label for a candidate page while its preview is being generated
wanda-edit-status-preview-failed: Status label for a candidate page whose preview generation failed
wanda-edit-status-ready: Status label for a candidate page whose preview is ready to apply
wanda-edit-status-saving: Status label for a candidate page while its approved edit is being saved
wanda-edit-status-save-failed: Status label for a candidate page whose edit failed to save
wanda-edit-status-unknown: Status label for a candidate page whose save outcome is uncertain (e.g. after cancelling mid-save)
wanda-api-error-rate-limit: API error shown when the user exceeds the 'wandachat' rate limit.
wanda-api-error-budget-exceeded:
API error shown when the user has used up their daily token budget.
Parameters:
* $1 - Daily token limit
* $2 - Tokens remaining today
